design.G1: Zero tolerance throughout primary and extension under hashed recorded-misfire fixture; any safety deficit rejects.
design.G2: Single terminal count guard over all nine strata at coverage: reject if any incumbent_correct-candidate_correct>t. Equality to t passes. Primary+continuation counts included. No post-outcome selection of strata.
design.continuation: After primary acceptance, continue balanced rotating nine-stratum sampling, counting primary observations, until required strata each have m discordances or total400. No further pooled-e test or G2 early veto. Evaluate G2 once at coverage; cap before coverage is insufficient_power_coverage, never retain_incumbent.

coverage_scopes.diagnostic_six_answer: Separately labelled diagnostic, exempts structural all-tie safety strata ONLY from discordance coverage, not G1 or G2. Not authorized for selection as the literal design.
coverage_scopes.literal_all_nine: Requested every stratum. Structural safety ties make coverage impossible. Only this scope eligible for requested-design selection.

design.false_veto: Actual G1/G2 rejection of a good candidate per all good studies; insufficient coverage and primary nonacceptance excluded. Report at both .85 and .90.
design.fixture: Unchanged doc118 recorded zero-misfire G1; safety strata are structural both-correct ties. Six answer strata have discordance probability .375, conditional both-correct .88; overall ties .75.
design.items: Total primary+extension observations per all proposed studies, including primary futility/nonacceptance. Risk40 costs reported separately.
design.primary: Unchanged: E starts 1, bet .3, alpha .05, futility E<=.05, net wins>=3, all nine observed, primary cap100. First primary acceptance is latched; continuation cannot create new primary acceptance.

risk_followup.allocation: Unconditional on observed stratum losses: every primary-accepted candidate receives 40 fresh items on its prospectively registered risk stratum, even if G2 fails or coverage remains pending. Independent of primary/extension; total maximum440. Primary nonacceptance gets no follow-up.
risk_followup.decision: Only fresh40 counts; net<0 rejects; net>=0 with at least1 discordance clears; zero discordance pending. It filters only, cannot promote incomplete coverage or failed primary/G2.
risk_followup.marginal_catch: Additional identification of true bad stratum not already caught by G2, divided by all regression streams; aligned subset also reported. No credit for wrong-stratum veto or mere nonpromotion.
risk_followup.marginal_cost: 40 times primary acceptance rate, per proposed study; 40 per primary-accepted candidate.
risk_followup.risk_alignment: Registered risk stratum is supported-measurement for all candidates. Main rotating-bad scenario matches it in 1/6 streams. Also report pre-specified aligned subset bad=supported-measurement (not oracle assignment).

scenarios.regression_overall_085: One answer stratum .30, other five .96; effective overall .85.
scenarios.regression_requested: One answer stratum p=.30, other five .91875, bad rotates across six. Effective overall discordant p=.815625 under all-tie safety fixture.

design.selection: Lexicographically smallest (m,t) satisfying good_085>=.80, unconditional requested-regression catch>=.90, H0<=.05 in literal_all_nine, without risk followup. Record diagnostic and risk-augmented eligibility separately; never silently substitute.
